options.completionDialogue: The north beach reopened after a suspiciously military cleanup. The only discoveries were ordinary resort litter and Botan's own missing equipment.

options.resultDialogue: Polka rides the driftwood for half a second before falling into the sand. Nene declares the driftwood her newest husband. Lamy quietly walks away before paperwork can form.
options.completionDialogue: The beach reopened with a four-second circus and one new wooden husband. No mystery artifact appeared, which Botan considers a successful operation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The north beach is ready for guests. Everything recovered was mundane, although Nene continues to dispute the classification of the map.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help holoForce arrange the VIP deck before the temperature spikes.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kanata is carrying ten loungers in one arm. Luna sits on top like royalty on a moving throne. Towa has a clipboard. Watame is chewing experimentally on a rope.

steps.prompt: The loungers are tied together in a knot the size of Luna. Towa says, 'We should untie it carefully.' Kanata cracks her fingers. Luna says, 'Destroy it, servant.'

options.resultDialogue: Kanata tugs once. The knot, rope, and one metal buckle become dust. Towa stares at the empty space. 'Technically untied.' Luna claps. 'Gorilla engineering!' Kanata turns red. 'Angel engineering!'
Towa cuts each rope with safety scissors. Watame gasps. 'So evil!' Towa freezes. 'Yes. Exactly. Fear my... responsible blade handling.'
Watame bites the rope, gets her wool tangled, and slowly tips over with three loungers attached. 'Manager, I may have become patio furniture.' Luna points. 'Put her in the shade.'

steps.prompt: A folded lounger rattles when Kanata lifts it. Luna points at it. 'Tribute.'

options.resultDialogue: A crumpled receipt falls out: one Super-Premium Princess Lunch charged to the Manager. Luna examines her nails. 'A princess requires nutrition.' Towa reads the total and quietly sits down.
Towa finds a single lost earplug. Watame leans closer. 'Maybe someone heard Kanata move the chairs.' Kanata frowns. 'I was quiet.' A lounger collapses behind her.
Watame finds one potato chip and eats it before anyone can react. Towa blinks. 'Evidence?' Watame smiles. 'Delicious evidence.'

steps.prompt: The VIP deck is aligned. Luna demands an official inspection ride.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata lifts Luna's lounger. Luna waves to confused tourists. 'Faster!' Kanata whispers to you, 'Manager, please declare the inspection complete before she discovers laps.'
options.completionDialogue: The VIP deck passed inspection after one unauthorized royal parade. The morning finding was ordinary lost property, although the lunch receipt remains financially supernatural.

options.resultDialogue: Luna steps down, takes three tiny steps, and points at the nearest chair. 'Inspection complete. Carry me back.' Towa writes, 'Mobility test: technically performed.'
options.completionDialogue: The loungers are ready for guests. Luna completed the shortest safety inspection in resort history and charged the Manager for lunch afterward.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The VIP deck is prepared. Nothing mysterious was found—only the consequences of Luna having access to the Manager's account.

noon.title: Day 6 — The Melting Point
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the resort is hot enough to cook lunch on the pavement. The Manager redirects every activity toward keeping guests safe—and quietly turns the crisis into preparation for tomorrow's Summer Games.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Save a sold-out fan meet after the cooling tent fails.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka is gripping a sold-out timetable. Hajime is measuring the queue with military seriousness. Kanade has the microphone. Raden is holding a folding fan like she already knows this will become history.

steps.prompt: The cooling system dies. Ririka says, 'We cannot cancel. I ordered commemorative towels.' Hajime asks, 'How many?' Ririka looks away. 'Enough to create a towel-based economy.'

options.resultDialogue: Hajime points at the crowd. 'Blue wristbands under the tent. Red wristbands by the fountain. Anyone standing in both lines is suspicious.' Kanade raises her hand. 'What if I'm standing in neither?' Hajime replies, 'Then you're the problem.'

options.text: Let Raden host the waiting area
options.resultDialogue: Raden begins a talk on historical summer festivals. Ten minutes later, the guests are taking notes. Ririka whispers, 'Can we charge tuition?' Raden keeps smiling. 'No.'
Kanade grabs the mic. 'GOOD NEWS! THE HEAT IS NOW PART OF THE EXPERIENCE!' Raden quietly switches the mic off. Kanade continues shouting without it. Somehow, the crowd answers anyway.

steps.prompt: The reorganized line blocks tomorrow's Summer Games registration desk. Ririka's eyes light up. 'What if the problem becomes a product?'

options.resultDialogue: Ririka adds a team-registration stamp to every fan card. Hajime checks each name. Kanade invents chants. 'Team Cold Noodles!' she screams. Hajime crosses it out. 'Not a team. Lunch order.'
You refuse. Ririka immediately sells numbered return slips. A guest pays extra for Number One. Hajime stares. 'You monetized waiting.' Ririka smiles. 'I monetized certainty.'
Teams must shout their names into Kanade's microphone. Raden judges dignity. Hajime judges confidence. Ririka sells recordings. One team yells so loudly the broken cooler restarts out of fear.

steps.prompt: The final guest leaves. What crowd plan does ReGLOSS submit for tomorrow?

options.resultDialogue: Hajime posts a clean timetable. Raden adds one tasteful cultural note. Kanade adds twelve exclamation marks. Ririka removes eleven. 'Compromise,' she says.
options.completionDialogue: The fan meet survived, and Day 7 now has a precise crowd plan. Hajime has been appointed temporary queue commander without being asked.

options.resultDialogue: Kanade leads one final chant. Ririka records the volume as proof of demand. Hajime folds her arms. 'Tomorrow's competitors had better be this loud when they lose.'
options.completionDialogue: The fan meet became an unofficial Summer Games rally. Registration is complete, and management has received a noise complaint for an event that has not started yet.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: ReGLOSS kept the guests entertained through the heat and established tomorrow's crowd-management plan. No findings occurred.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Promise inspect tomorrow’s obstacle-course route without melting.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fauna is carrying water and sunscreen. Kronii has timed the route to the second. Bae is dragging a box labeled CHAOS SUPPLIES. Mumei is staring at the course map upside down and nodding thoughtfully.

steps.prompt: The planned route crosses an exposed stretch of beach. Kronii says, 'At this pace, the athletes will lose seven minutes.' Fauna replies, 'At this temperature, they may also lose consciousness.'

options.resultDialogue: Fauna guides vines over temporary arches. Bae ducks beneath them. 'This lane has no explosions.' Fauna smiles. 'Correct.' Bae whispers to you, 'Nature is oppressing innovation.'
Kronii marks hydration pauses at mathematically perfect intervals. Mumei points at the map. 'Why is there a break inside the pond?' Kronii looks down. The map is upside down. 'Give me that.'
Bae scatters harmless foam obstacles across one section. 'Now the heat is only the second-biggest problem!' Fauna looks at you. 'Manager, I need you to understand that was not reassurance.'

steps.prompt: The survey reaches the central pond, which may still carry consequences from an earlier route.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna studies the blackened shoreline. 'The trees remember.' Bae slowly hides her CHAOS SUPPLIES behind Kronii. Kronii steps aside. 'Do not make me part of the evidence.'
Ducks drift across the water. Fauna smiles. 'See? Nature rewards restraint.' Mumei points at a duck. 'That one owes me money.' Nobody asks why.

options.text: Ask Mumei to mark the checkpoint
options.resultDialogue: Mumei plants a flag beside the pond. Kronii checks the map. 'That is the finish line.' Mumei nods. 'Then they finish early.' Bae applauds the revolutionary design.

steps.prompt: Promise must submit one final route recommendation.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna approves the route. Kronii adjusts the schedule by exactly ninety seconds. Bae sighs. 'Fine. But I want one legal surprise.' Fauna hands her a mister bottle. 'Use this responsibly.'
options.completionDialogue: Promise approved a shaded, timed course for Day 7. Bae has been granted one regulated surprise and is treating the mister bottle like classified equipment.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii writes three emergency stop times. Fauna adds hydration staff. Bae signs the plan with a paw print and the words DEFINITELY SAFE. Mumei adds, 'Probably.'
options.completionDialogue: Tomorrow's course includes one controlled-chaos section under strict supervision. The words 'strict supervision' have done most of the work in that sentence.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Promise completed the route survey and prepared tomorrow's course. No objects were found; the only danger was Bae having access to labels.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Turn AREA 15’s darkened café into a cooling station for tomorrow’s athletes.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Moona has dimmed the café until it resembles midnight. Iofi is painting luminous menus. Risu is renting tiny reading lamps for a price that suggests each lamp contains a personal sun.

steps.prompt: A guest squints at the menu. 'I can't read anything.' Risu appears beside them holding a lamp. 'Conveniently, I have a solution.'

options.resultDialogue: Iofi paints every item in luminous green. Moona looks around. 'It resembles an alien nightclub.' Iofi beams. 'Thank you.' Risu whispers, 'Can we charge an extraterrestrial service fee?'
Moona creates a soft moon above every booth. The guests applaud. Risu immediately places a sign: PRIVATE MOONLIGHT — PREMIUM SEATING. Moona turns to her. 'Risu.' 'Business moon,' Risu corrects.
Risu hands out lamps at emergency pricing. Iofi reads the sign. 'You added a breathing fee.' Risu covers the bottom line with her tail. 'Optional premium oxygen.'

steps.prompt: The cooling concept works too well. Summer Games staff ask AREA 15 to operate tomorrow's athlete recovery lounge.

options.resultDialogue: Moona designs quiet cooling booths. Iofi labels hydration levels with simple icons. Risu asks, 'Where is the luxury tier?' Moona points at the free water. 'That is the luxury tier.' Risu looks personally betrayed.

Iofi turns the lounge into a glowing photo spot. Moona adds soft moonlight. Risu sells priority pictures. 'Recovery happens faster with branding,' she explains. You do not believe her, but the queue does.
Risu unveils Bronze Hydration, Silver Hydration, and Platinum Hydration Plus. Iofi checks the cups. 'These are all water.' Risu nods. 'Different emotional value.'

steps.prompt: Moona needs one final operating policy for Day 7.

options.resultDialogue: Moona approves free water and shade. Risu clutches her chest. 'Free?' Iofi pats her back. 'You can sell the souvenir cups.' Risu recovers instantly.
options.completionDialogue: AREA 15 established a practical recovery lounge for the Summer Games. Water is free; the commemorative cup is somehow not.

options.resultDialogue: Iofi signs the glowing photo wall. Moona dims the room dramatically. Risu announces three pricing tiers before anyone asks. 'Health, memories, profit. Balanced.'
options.completionDialogue: The recovery lounge will double as a moonlit spectator attraction. Athletes can cool down, guests can take photos, and Risu can apparently monetize darkness.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: AREA 15 solved the heat problem and prepared tomorrow's recovery lounge. No findings occurred, unless management counts Risu discovering another fee.

evening.title: Day 6 — Summer Games Eve
evening.openingDialogue: The temperature finally drops. Instead of resting, three teams begin building equipment, testing ceremony effects, and finalizing rules for tomorrow's first resort-wide Summer Games.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help holoh3ro build equipment for tomorrow’s games.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela is forging a relay baton as if it must survive a meteor. Zeta is testing grip patterns in secret-agent gloves. Kobo has attached streamers, bells, and something she insists is 'speed water.'

steps.prompt: The official relay baton must be finished tonight. Kaela asks, 'Durable or light?' Kobo raises both hands. 'Loud.'

options.resultDialogue: Kaela produces a baton heavy enough to dent the table. Zeta lifts it with both hands. 'This is not sports equipment. This is evidence.' Kaela nods. 'It will not break.'
Zeta trims the weight and adds a textured grip. Kobo snatches it, spins once, and drops it on her foot. Zeta writes, 'Field test successful. User failure.'
Kobo adds bells and streamers. Kaela watches the baton whistle when moved. 'It is less efficient.' Kobo hugs it. 'It has morale.' Zeta whispers, 'It has a location beacon.'

steps.prompt: The arena banner tears during testing. It must survive tomorrow's opening ceremony.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela adds metal brackets. The banner now weighs as much as a small car. Kobo stares upward. 'If it falls, do we still win?' Zeta replies, 'We win a lawsuit.'
Zeta installs a controlled release system. Kobo pulls the wrong cord and the banner wraps around Kaela. Kaela stands perfectly still. 'Again.' Kobo runs.
Kobo paints a giant smiling sun over the tear. Kaela points at the visible crack. 'Still damaged.' Kobo points at the smile. 'But emotionally repaired.'

steps.prompt: Which equipment philosophy is submitted for Day 7?

options.resultDialogue: Kaela signs the checklist. Zeta adds safety notes. Kobo writes, 'BORING BUT STRONG' across the top. Kaela looks at it. 'Correct.'
options.completionDialogue: holoh3ro prepared sturdy Summer Games equipment capable of surviving athletes, weather, and Kobo's opinions.

options.resultDialogue: Kobo rings the baton like a victory bell. Zeta adds tracking tags. Kaela reinforces everything just enough that nobody dies. 'Compromise,' Zeta says. Kaela replies, 'Temporary compromise.'
options.completionDialogue: Tomorrow's equipment will be colorful, loud, and secretly reinforced by Kaela so the spectacle survives contact with reality.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: holoh3ro completed the Summer Games equipment. No findings occurred; every unusual object was deliberately manufactured by Kobo.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help holoX test the Summer Games opening effects without creating the first casualty.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui has permits, emergency switches, and a headache. Koyori has several unapproved liquids. La+ has written 'SUPREME COMMANDER ENTRANCE' across the schedule. Chloe is sitting on the cable case because someone told her to guard it.

steps.prompt: Koyori unveils a glowing effect mixture. Lui asks, 'Has this been tested?' Koyori smiles. 'Define tested.'

options.resultDialogue: Iroha releases a small sample from behind a shield. It produces a neat ring of light. La+ squints. 'Where is the terror?' Lui replies, 'Removed during budgeting.'
The effect creates a purple cloud shaped like La+'s head. La+ points upward. 'The heavens recognize their ruler!' Lui checks the wind. 'The cloud is drifting toward the hotel.'
La+ walks through smoke while Koyori triggers the lights. Chloe opens the wrong case and releases a shower of paper coupons. La+ continues posing. 'The tribute has begun.'

steps.prompt: The effects console starts flashing every cue at once. Lui points at the emergency switch. 'Nobody panic.' Chloe immediately panics.

options.resultDialogue: Lui hits the master switch. Everything stops except one spotlight on La+. La+ crosses her arms. 'The system understands hierarchy.' Lui mutters, 'The system is broken.'
Iroha moves through the console faster than anyone can follow. The lights stabilize. Chloe looks at the cables. 'I helped by not touching anything.' Lui nods. 'Your finest technical contribution.'
Koyori pours in a clear solution. Every effect becomes harmless streamers that bury Chloe to her shoulders. Chloe blinks. 'Am I safe?' Lui says, 'Safer than the paperwork.'

steps.prompt: Lui must approve one ceremony plan.

options.resultDialogue: Lui signs a controlled plan. Iroha receives emergency authority. Koyori is limited to approved mixtures. La+ quietly writes her entrance back into the margin. Lui circles it and writes NO.
options.completionDialogue: holoX approved a safe opening light show. It should begin on time unless La+ finds the smoke controls or Koyori redefines 'approved.'

options.resultDialogue: Lui adds three shutoffs, two fire blankets, and one clause reading LA+ MAY NOT IMPROVISE. La+ signs beneath it: AGREED, EXCEPT FOR IMPROVISATION.
options.completionDialogue: holoX approved a dramatic Summer Games opening with redundant safety systems. The ceremony will be spectacular or become its own competition event.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The ceremony rehearsal ended without a real explosion. No findings occurred, and Lui now considers that a major victory.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Advent finish the rulebook when the archive displays tomorrow’s results early.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori is editing the official rules. Nerissa is testing announcements. Bijou is sitting on the registration desk like a decorative paperweight. Fuwawa and Mococo are stamping paw marks on every page they can reach.

steps.prompt: The archive screen displays a completed entry for tomorrow's First Week Finale. Shiori reads it twice. 'The event has not happened.' Bijou points at the winner field. 'It keeps changing. Very balanced matchmaking.'

options.resultDialogue: Bijou starts fixing the formatting. Each correction changes the listed winner. Fuwawa says, 'Maybe everyone wins!' Mococo gasps. 'That sounds expensive!' Ririka is not present, yet the room somehow feels her disapproval.

Nerissa reads the winner line aloud. The team name becomes musical symbols, and the prize changes to LIGHTHOUSE CALIBRATION PRISM. Nerissa lowers the page. 'That was not in rehearsal.' Shiori smiles. 'Now it is interesting.'

Shiori lays an older resort form beside the screen. 'Same wording, same seal, tomorrow's date.' Bijou leans closer. 'So the island preloaded spoilers?' Shiori replies, 'The island has poor etiquette.'

steps.prompt: The twins stamp the printed draft. The terminal immediately adds: ALL UNITS AND ALLIANCES ARE ELIGIBLE.

options.resultDialogue: Fuwawa and Mococo cheer. 'We invented teamwork!' Bijou says, 'Teams already existed.' The twins point at the paw stamp. 'Not officially.' Shiori admits the timing is suspiciously convenient.
You restore the original rule. The terminal waits three seconds, then adds TEMPORARY ALLIANCES PERMITTED DURING EMERGENCIES. Nerissa looks at the screen. 'Did it already schedule an emergency?'
Bijou rewrites the sentence with team-size limits and substitution rules. The screen displays a tiny lighthouse-shaped approval icon. Bijou points proudly. 'The system accepts gamer law.'

steps.prompt: The rulebook is ready, but the impossible result remains. What goes into the Manager's report?

options.resultDialogue: Shiori copies the phrase exactly. Nerissa circles CALIBRATION. Bijou writes FINAL BOSS LOOT underneath it. Shiori adds, 'Unofficial annotation.' Bijou adds a second underline.
options.completionDialogue: Advent completed the rulebook and documented an advance reference to a Lighthouse Calibration Prism. No object was found, and the archive prediction remains unverified.

options.text: Treat it as a resort teaser
options.resultDialogue: You label the message promotional material. The twins immediately run outside shouting, 'MYSTERIOUS LIGHTHOUSE PRIZE TOMORROW! BAU BAU!' Shiori keeps a private copy. 'For quality control,' she says.
options.completionDialogue: Advent turned the archive anomaly into a Summer Games teaser. Guests now expect a lighthouse prize, while the staff quietly wonders why tomorrow's result already exists.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Advent completed the rulebook, introduced mixed-unit eligibility, and left one unresolved clue for Day 7. No finding occurred.

days.storyBeat: The first Hololive Resort Summer Games open the island to established units, beloved pairings, and temporary alliances. Friendly competition quickly becomes sabotage, improvised warfare, and emergency teamwork before the ceremonial trophy reveals a Lighthouse Calibration Prism tied to an impossible fourth pier.

morning.title: Day 7 — Opening Preparations
morning.openingDialogue: The resort gates open to drums, cheering tourists, and an air horn pointed directly at the Manager's office. Three groups are preparing the parade, stage, and sponsorship booths. None of them agree on what 'ready' means.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help HoloTori rehearse the opening parade. Subaru is still filing objections to the team name.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A gigantic bird-shaped float blocks the resort entrance. Kiara stands on top wearing a FLOCK LEADER sash. 'HoloTori shall descend upon the games!' Subaru looks at the wheels. 'We're driving fifteen meters.' Kiara spreads her arms. 'We shall descend horizontally.'

steps.prompt: HoloTori needs an opening formation. Who gets control of the float?

options.resultDialogue: Kiara assigns herself to the front. 'I am the glorious point of the flock!' Subaru stares at her assigned position. 'Why am I second?' Kiara puts a hand on her shoulder. 'You are the dependable backbone.' 'I thought I wasn't a bird!' Everyone leans outward on Kiara's signal. Mumei leans the opposite way, and the float begins turning in a slow circle. Lui grips the railing. 'Mumei, wrong wing!' Mumei looks behind her. 'I wondered why everyone was leaving.'

Lui takes Kiara's formation chart, folds it twice, and places it under a traffic cone. 'We are using a straight line.' Kiara gasps. 'A straight line has no drama!' Lui points at the brakes. 'It has these.' Reine asks where elegance fits. 'After survival.' Lui gives Subaru the route whistle. Subaru frowns. 'Why am I controlling traffic?' 'Because people listen when you shout.' Mumei raises her hand. 'I don't.' Lui gives Subaru a second whistle.

Mumei unfolds a napkin covered in spirals. 'We start here, pass the little face, and finish at the star.' Subaru points at the label: PROBABLY A TREE. Lui checks the road. 'This route leads through the fountain.' Reine nods. 'A water feature could improve the reflections.' Five minutes later, the float is half full of water. Kiara keeps waving. 'HoloTori has become amphibious!' Subaru grabs a bucket. 'THAT IS NOT AN UPGRADE!'

steps.prompt: The float's enormous wing catches the welcome banner and begins pulling down the entrance arch.

options.text: Let Reine perform an elegant pivot
options.resultDialogue: Reine takes the wheel. 'A peafowl never panics before an audience.' The float slides sideways with perfect control until Kiara's decorative tail catches a traffic cone. The cone launches into the air and lands on Subaru's head. The guests cheer. Subaru removes it slowly. 'Why did they like that?' Reine smiles. 'Physical comedy crosses language barriers.' Mumei reaches for the cone. 'Can I have it?' 'No,' Subaru and Lui answer together.

Subaru blows one sharp note. Every HoloTori member immediately turns toward her. Kiara blinks. 'Why did I do that?' Reine straightens. 'Remarkably authoritative.' A tourist shouts, 'THE DUCK COMMANDS THE FLOCK!' The crowd chants DUCK until Subaru's face turns red. Under her furious directions, the group clears the banner perfectly. Kiara pats her shoulder. 'Our leader.' Subaru points the whistle at her. 'I WILL WALK HOME.'

options.text: Let Kiara burn the ribbon free
options.resultDialogue: Kiara raises a hand. 'A phoenix solution is required.' Lui grabs the extinguisher. 'No.' 'A tiny flame.' 'No.' 'A tasteful flame.' 'No.' Kiara snaps anyway. The ribbon burns free and drops into the confetti cannon. Gold paper buries Mumei and wraps Subaru like a present. Kiara throws her arms open. 'Behold! The planned finale!' Lui sprays the smoking cannon. 'We are still in rehearsal.' Mumei's voice rises from the pile. 'I liked the ending.'

steps.prompt: The gates open early. Hundreds of guests begin following the rehearsal as if it were the real parade.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru takes the whistle. 'Left! Right! Kiara, both feet on the float!' Kiara raises one boot onto the railing. 'I require elevation for leadership!' 'You require both feet attached for safety!' Reine waves elegantly while Lui keeps the float centered. Mumei throws petals until she forgets why and decorates herself. They reach the arena without hitting a wall. Kiara admits, 'Your plan was effective.' Lui smiles. Kiara adds, 'It lacked fire.' Lui immediately regrets mentioning tonight's fireworks.
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori completed the parade without destroying the avenue. Subaru's whistle became the official starting signal despite her formal objection to being called Flock Commander.

options.text: Turn the crowd into the flock
options.resultDialogue: The guests copy every movement. Kiara raises her arms; five hundred people follow. Mumei crouches to tie her shoe; half the crowd crouches. 'I have power,' she whispers. Lui points at her. 'No experiments.' Subaru directs everyone toward the arena, but Korone hears the whistle and starts sprinting with them. Okayu watches her pass. 'Have fun.' Korone leads the entire crowd across the first obstacle course before the games start.
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori transformed the parade into a five-hundred-person migration. Korone recorded the first unofficial course time, and the grounds crew is still returning spectators to their seats.

options.resultDialogue: The float accelerates. Subaru grips the railing. 'WHY DOES A PARADE FLOAT HAVE THIS MUCH SPEED?!' Reine holds down her feathers. 'My elegance is becoming aerodynamic!' Mumei watches the ramp. 'Oh. We're flying.' For three seconds, HoloTori is genuinely airborne. They land in the foam pit, burying everyone except Kiara. Lui's hand rises from the foam. 'This was not authorized.' Kiara poses against the sunrise. 'They cannot hear you over history.'
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori achieved three seconds of flight before landing beside the first obstacle. The guests called it spectacular; the course marshal called it debris.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: HoloTori completed the opening parade. The crowd was delighted, the float may still be on the course, and Subaru has submitted another written objection to the word bird.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help FLOW GLOW prepare team entrances, music cues, and an effects system that reacts to confidence.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Su is connected to three control panels. Vivi is testing the microphone with percussion noises. Riona practices a flawless entrance, Niko keeps renaming the buttons, and Chihaya is the only person reading the actual program.

steps.prompt: The opening-stage system must assign entrance music to every team. Su says the software is ready. The screen immediately labels Shiranui Kensetsu as HEAVY MACHINERY.

options.resultDialogue: Su adjusts the sensor. 'It selects music based on competitive aura.' Riona steps onto the mark and receives a stadium anthem. Niko steps on and gets a suspicious saxophone solo. 'The machine understands me,' Niko says. Chihaya tries it and receives silence. She stares at Su. Su checks the panel. 'Too cool. Signal froze.'

options.text: Let Vivi assign the tracks live
options.resultDialogue: Vivi beatboxes each team name into the console. The system accepts every sound until Kanade yells from across the plaza and accidentally registers a team called AAAAAAAAA. Riona reads the screen. 'They have excellent audience support.' Su replies, 'They do not exist.'

Niko renames the cues: HEROIC, MYSTERIOUS, DANGEROUS, and EXTREMELY DATEABLE. Chihaya points at the last category. 'Which team is that?' Niko taps her own portrait. 'The system requested accuracy.' Riona drags her away from the keyboard by the shoulders.

steps.prompt: The holoX effects console connects to FLOW GLOW's stage. Every dramatic sentence now triggers smoke, lights, or streamers.

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya tests the microphone. 'Welcome to the Summer Games.' A clean ring of light appears. Riona says, 'That was tasteful.' Nothing happens. She leans closer. 'That was dramatic.' Still nothing. Niko whispers, 'The system does not respect her.' Riona spends the next minute arguing with a spotlight.

Vivi shouts, 'ARE YOU READY?' Purple smoke erupts, a giant La+ silhouette appears above the stage, and the speakers announce SUPREME COMMANDER ENTRANCE. Lui sprints in from backstage. 'That was not this cue!' La+ appears inside the projection and waves. 'It is now.'

Su unplugs the effects cable. Vivi supplies percussion with her mouth, Chihaya performs the announcement perfectly, and Niko throws handfuls of glitter on every important word. Riona watches glitter enter the ventilation system. 'This is why technology was invented.' Su replies, 'Technology refused.'

steps.prompt: The first competitors arrive early and demand entrance previews. FLOW GLOW can test one final presentation style.

options.text: Give every team a heroic entrance
options.resultDialogue: Su queues the music. Vivi announces each team with escalating intensity. By the time OkaKoro enters, the speakers call them THE UNSTOPPABLE SOVEREIGNS OF PEACEFUL DESTRUCTION. Okayu yawns. Korone punches the air so hard a banner falls down. Chihaya checks the script. 'We may have oversold them.' Okayu points at Korone. 'Maybe not.'
options.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW completed a heroic opening package for every team. The crowd is excited, the speakers are exhausted, and OkaKoro now has an unnecessarily threatening title.

options.resultDialogue: Riona asks the crowd to choose each team's effect by cheering. The first team receives lights. The second receives smoke. Shiranui Kensetsu receives every effect at once because Polka starts conducting the audience. Flare disappears inside the smoke and shouts, 'POLKA!' Polka answers from a cannon of streamers, 'THE PEOPLE HAVE SPOKEN!'
options.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW turned team entrances into a live audience vote. The system works, although Polka has learned that applause can be weaponized.

options.resultDialogue: Niko gives every team a theatrical nickname. FAMS becomes THE SMILING THREAT. Shiranui Kensetsu becomes BUILDING CODE VIOLATION. OkaKoro becomes CAT AND DOG, LEGALLY UNMONITORED. Mio reads her team's title. 'Why are we a threat?' Fubuki quietly closes a notebook labeled LOOPHOLES. 'No reason.'
options.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW completed the opening introductions. Every team now has a dramatic title, and several have already filed objections before competing.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW prepared the Summer Games opening stage. No findings occurred, but several teams received titles they may never escape.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Stop Pekora and Marine from monetizing the Summer Games into insolvency.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Pekora guards a stack of suspicious shortcut maps. Marine is posing beside a towel large enough to cover the stage. A sign reads OFFICIAL SPONSORS, although management has not approved either sponsor.

steps.prompt: The official merchandise booth has no pricing plan. Pekora and Marine have prepared competing proposals.

options.resultDialogue: Pekora flips the sign from 100 SHELLS to 300 the moment a crowd forms. 'Supply and demand-peko.' Marine points at a towel. 'That was one hundred ten seconds ago.' Pekora changes it to 400. 'Historical pricing no longer applies.'

Marine unveils a towel bearing a life-sized illustration of herself. 'Official Senchou Victory Towel!' You hold it up. 'Marine, this is a bedsheet.' She poses beside it. 'Victory should be visible from the lighthouse.' Pekora checks the production cost and quietly orders two thousand.

You post a fixed-price list. Pekora stares at it as if you have outlawed carrots. Marine reads the prices. 'Where is the premium Senchou interaction fee?' 'There isn't one.' Marine places a tip jar labeled EMOTIONAL SALVAGE. Pekora nods. 'We adapt-peko.'

steps.prompt: Pekora reveals a new product: an Official Strategic Shortcut Map. Marine notices several arrows lead through staff-only areas.

options.resultDialogue: You take the stack. Pekora gasps. 'Those are legitimate navigational interpretations-peko!' Marine studies one. 'This arrow ends inside the freezer.' Pekora taps the legend. 'High-risk route.' You hand the maps to security. Gigi immediately marks them EVIDENCE and runs away with all of them.

Marine stamps NOT FOR NAVIGATION across every map. Pekora adds FOR ENTERTAINMENT ONLY in letters too small to see. A tourist buys one and asks where it leads. Marine smiles. 'Adventure.' Pekora whispers, 'The kitchen loading dock-peko.'

options.text: Let Pekora sponsor a real shortcut
options.resultDialogue: You allow one marked route after safety checks. Pekora installs a sign reading PEKO EXPRESS and adds a toll gate. Marine stands beside it in a ceremonial coat. 'Senchou shall bless all travelers.' You point at the cash box. 'Free route.' Both women look away at exactly the same time.

steps.prompt: Pekora places three gold passes labeled IMMUNITY FROM PENALTIES on the referee table. Marine insists they are promotional props. Pekora is already wearing one.

options.resultDialogue: You tear up the passes. Pekora drops to her knees. 'Manager has destroyed innovation-peko!' Marine places a hand on her shoulder. 'Do not grieve. Senchou has already sold the commemorative replicas.' You turn slowly. Marine immediately adds, 'Nonfunctional replicas.'
options.completionDialogue: PekoMari opened the merchandise booth under strict rules. The fake immunity passes were destroyed, although Marine sold replicas before management finished the announcement.

options.resultDialogue: The gold passes become coupons allowing spectators to assign one harmless foam obstacle to a team. Pekora's eyes widen. 'Crowdfunded sabotage-peko.' Marine raises a finger. 'Interactive entertainment.' You add five pages of restrictions while they discuss premium voting packages.
options.completionDialogue: PekoMari converted illegal penalty passes into regulated audience obstacle coupons. Management calls it engagement; the competitors call it a targeted attack.

options.resultDialogue: You redirect the booth profits into helmets, padding, and recovery supplies. Pekora stares at the invoice. 'We earned money and then spent it on other people?' Marine puts on a gold helmet. 'Senchou looks excellent in public safety.' Pekora considers this, then orders branded helmets at triple price.
options.completionDialogue: PekoMari funded the tournament safety equipment. Every helmet now has either rabbit ears or Marine's autograph, but they are technically protective.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: PekoMari completed the sponsorship setup. No findings occurred, but the line between merchandise and competitive interference is now five pages of legal text.

noon.title: Day 7 — The First Hololive Resort Summer Games
noon.openingDialogue: The stands are full, the course is armed with foam obstacles, and the referees have already confiscated three suspicious devices from Pekora. Choose one team to manage through the full tournament. Noon is today's only finding window.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Manage Flare, Miko, Suisei, Noel, and Polka through the full Summer Games tournament.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare has a safe strategy, Miko has an elite strategy, Polka has loaded a cannon, Noel is carrying the equipment tent, and Suisei is calmly asking which competitors are considered obstacles.

steps.prompt: Shiranui Kensetsu gathers at the starting tent. Flare opens the rulebook. Miko opens a second paper labeled ELITE RULEBOOK.

options.resultDialogue: Flare points at the schedule. 'We conserve energy, protect the equipment, and do not improvise.' Miko slowly lowers a glitter-covered lever behind her back. Polka raises her hand. 'Can we improvise safely?' Noel asks, 'Can I carry the schedule?' Suisei looks at Flare. 'Do you want me to remove the lever or Miko?' Flare closes her eyes. 'The lever.'

Miko slaps down a hand-drawn map. 'These red lines are elite routes.' Flare points at one. 'That goes through the staff kitchen.' 'Food checkpoint.' Another ends at the ocean. 'Water shortcut.' Suisei studies the map. 'This one cuts through the referee booth.' Miko beams. 'Efficiency.'

Polka unfurls a banner reading SHIRAKEN: BUILDING VICTORY SINCE THIS MORNING. 'Every event needs an entrance, a mid-event entrance, and an emergency entrance!' Flare asks, 'What is an emergency entrance?' A cannon rolls out from behind the tent. Noel lifts it onto her shoulder. 'Portable.' Flare looks at Suisei. Suisei shrugs. 'I want to see where this goes.'

steps.prompt: Round One is the mascot relay: carry a giant resort sun through the obstacle course without damaging it.

options.resultDialogue: Noel lifts the mascot, its platform, and two confused course marshals at once. 'It was faster than unloading them.' Subaru blows the referee whistle. 'PUT THE OFFICIALS DOWN!' Noel sets them gently beside the finish line. The platform bends into a U-shape. Noel stares at it. 'I was careful.' Flare pats her shoulder. 'You were Noel-careful.'

Suisei takes the front position. The first foam wall blocks the lane. She raises the relay baton. Flare says, 'It is foam.' Suisei replies, 'Then it will be easy.' Three precise strikes later, the lane is perfectly clear and every neighboring team is standing very still. Pekora whispers from the next lane, 'Why did they give her a weapon-peko?'

Miko unveils a cart labeled ELITE EXPRESS. Flare checks the steering wheel. 'Why does left turn it right?' Miko grips the handles. 'Advanced controls.' The cart launches backward, carries the mascot through the spectator photo zone, and returns with Marine clinging to the roof. Marine raises one hand. 'Senchou has been kidnapped by infrastructure!'

steps.prompt: Pekora plants a sign reading OFFICIAL SHORTCUT. It points through a narrow service lane lined with catering carts.

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth inspects the sign. 'This bears no official seal.' Pekora points at a carrot sticker. 'That is the seal-peko.' Cecilia scans it. 'Adhesive vegetable. Fraud probability: ninety-nine percent.' Gigi stamps BIRD across the evidence tag for no reason. Pekora tries to run. Suisei calmly blocks the exit with the baton. 'Sit.' Pekora sits.

Miko shouts, 'Elite route confirmed!' The team charges through the service lane. A waiter opens a freezer door. Polka ducks, Noel carries everyone over a soup cart, and Flare catches six bowls without spilling one. They emerge ahead of the other teams. Pekora appears at a toll gate. 'Shortcut licensing fee-peko.' Suisei raises the baton. Pekora waives the fee.

options.text: Reverse the sign toward Pekora's lane
options.resultDialogue: Polka rotates the sign while Pekora is not looking. Pekora sprints into the service lane, crashes through a stack of empty boxes, and emerges wearing a salad bowl as a helmet. 'Sabotage-peko!' Miko points at the sign. 'Official route.' Flare quietly turns away so nobody sees her laughing.

steps.prompt: Round Two requires each team to move guest supplies across the wave pool using one raft and no powered engines.

options.resultDialogue: Flare sketches a simple raft. Noel holds the frame, Polka ties the ropes, and Miko adds a decorative shrine gate despite three objections. Suisei pushes off with one stroke strong enough to create a wake. The raft reaches the far side intact. The shrine gate does not. It floats past Miko. 'Temporary separation-nye.'

options.text: Let Noel throw the supplies across
options.resultDialogue: Noel picks up the first crate. Subaru raises the whistle. 'The rules say transport, not launch!' Noel pauses. Fubuki checks her copy. 'Actually, it doesn't specify continuous contact with the water.' Mio grabs Fubuki's rulebook. 'We are not helping them weaponize grammar.' Noel throws anyway. Every crate lands safely. One embeds itself halfway into the sand.

Polka stands on the bow with a flag while Miko provides drum noises. The raft moves slowly, but the crowd begins clapping in rhythm. Suisei uses the applause to time each paddle stroke. They cross in perfect synchronization until Polka fires a confetti cannon backward and accelerates the raft into the dock. Flare climbs out soaked. 'We arrived. I refuse to discuss the method.'

steps.prompt: The scoreboard ranks Shiranui Kensetsu first in Structural Intimidation but deducts points for Unscheduled Architecture.

options.resultDialogue: Flare approaches Cecilia with a folder. 'Which structure was unscheduled?' Cecilia displays images of Miko's cart, Polka's cannon, and Noel's U-shaped platform. Flare turns one page, then closes the folder. 'I withdraw the question.' Behind her, Miko whispers, 'Coward.' Flare answers without turning. 'Employee.'

Miko slams the ELITE RULEBOOK onto the table. 'All architecture is scheduled if destiny wanted it!' Elizabeth reads the cover. 'This is a restaurant placemat.' Miko points to a crayon signature. 'Official.' Suisei leans toward the referee. 'How many points if she stops talking?' Cecilia answers, 'Potentially several.'

options.text: Let Polka win the crowd vote
options.resultDialogue: Polka grabs the announcer microphone. 'DOES THE CROWD CONSIDER THIS UNSCHEDULED?!' The audience chants NO. Cecilia checks the meter. 'Audience bonus exceeds architecture penalty.' Flare stares at the scoreboard. 'That cannot be how rules work.' Elizabeth clears her throat. 'The crowd has become precedent.'

steps.prompt: Before the final relay, the giant sun-banner tears loose above the guest seats. One support cable snaps toward the crowd.

options.text: Stop competing and secure the banner
options.resultDialogue: Flare orders an immediate rescue. Noel catches the falling support with both hands. Suisei slices the loose cable before it whips across the seats. Polka directs guests away with a circus march while Miko holds the support and shouts, 'Elite emergency pillar!' The other teams pass them on the course. Flare watches the scoreboard drop. 'Guests first.' Suisei nods. 'We can catch up.'

options.text: Repair it without leaving the race
options.resultDialogue: Noel carries the team platform beneath the banner while Flare and Polka reattach the line in motion. Miko steers the cart with one hand and waves with the other. Suisei knocks a falling bracket into an empty safety net. The crowd cheers. Flare looks down. 'We are performing maintenance during a relay.' Polka grins. 'Shiranui Kensetsu finally found its sport!'

options.text: Trust another team and keep racing
options.resultDialogue: FAMS moves toward the banner as Shiranui Kensetsu continues. Mio shouts, 'We've got it!' Fubuki adds, 'You owe us!' Suisei looks back once, then accelerates. Miko pumps a fist. 'Strategic friendship outsourcing!' Flare replies, 'Call it teamwork before Mio hears you.'

steps.prompt: The final relay begins. Shiranui Kensetsu is close enough to win, but the last obstacle is a collapsing foam fortress guarded by Pekora's remote detonator.

options.resultDialogue: Flare orders a clean formation. Noel braces the fortress, Polka passes the baton through the safe gap, Miko follows the marked lane for once, and Suisei takes the final sprint. Pekora presses the detonator. Nothing happens. Flare holds up the removed battery. 'Safety inspection.' Suisei crosses the line first and hands Pekora the dead remote. 'You dropped this.' Pekora faints from professional humiliation.

Miko follows her glitter map directly into the fortress wall. Noel punches an opening, Polka launches through it from the parade cannon, and Suisei catches the airborne baton without slowing down. Pekora triggers the foam charges. The blast launches Miko over the finish line headfirst. She rises from the padding with smoke in her hair. 'Calculated elite landing!' Flare looks at the crater. 'We are never calculating again.'

options.text: Turn the finale into Polka's grand show
options.resultDialogue: Polka fires the team cannon at the fortress. It does not destroy the foam; it launches her directly into Pekora. Both disappear behind the wall with a loud BONK. Noel carries the fortress ten meters, Miko rides on top waving a flag, and Suisei walks through the newly cleared lane. Polka crawls from the foam beside an unconscious Pekora. 'Audience loved it.' The scoreboard confirms she is correct.

options.text: Abandon first place to protect a fallen rival
options.resultDialogue: A rival competitor is knocked unconscious by the collapsing foam wall. Flare stops the team. Noel lifts the wall, Suisei carries the competitor to safety, Polka keeps the crowd calm, and Miko drags the baton across the line last. The audience rises in a standing ovation. Miko looks at the scoreboard. 'We lost.' Flare points at the cheering stands. 'Not everything is that board.' Suisei adds, 'Also, we can blame Pekora.'

steps.prompt: Shiranui Kensetsu wins the official championship. Elizabeth lifts the lighthouse-shaped trophy, but its base opens by itself.

options.text: Let Suisei inspect the silver prism
options.resultDialogue: A triangular silver prism rises from the trophy. Suisei catches it before it falls. The surface reflects a shoreline with four piers instead of three. 'That is not our map,' she says. Cecilia's gears accelerate. 'Lighthouse Calibration Prism identified. Infrastructure response detected.' Miko leans into the reflection. 'Is the fourth pier elite?' Flare pulls her back. 'Do not register it as company property.'

AZKi checks the recording. Beneath their voices is a mechanical announcement: CALIBRATION ONE OF FOUR COMPLETE. Sora looks at the dark lighthouse. 'Then we have three songs left?' AZKi smiles. 'Hopefully not tonight.'
options.completionDialogue: SorAZ completed the closing concert while the prism synchronized with the lighthouse. The fourth pier appeared for three seconds, and the recording captured the message CALIBRATION ONE OF FOUR COMPLETE.

options.resultDialogue: Sora leads the audience into an encore while AZKi lowers the prism's tone beneath the music. The fourth pier fades gradually, almost unnoticed. After the applause, AZKi shows you the waveform. A second signal continues after the song ends, pointing toward the empty water. 'The concert stopped,' she says. 'The lighthouse did not.'
options.completionDialogue: SorAZ gave the resort a peaceful finale, but the lighthouse continued transmitting toward the vanished fourth pier after the music ended.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: SorAZ completed the Summer Games concert. No new object was found, but their music synchronized the prism and briefly made the fourth pier visible.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Lead the ceremonial flame to the lighthouse while every torch bends toward the missing pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kiara has three torches, Subaru has the safety manual, Reine has replaced half the flames with elegant lanterns, Lui has a route plan, and Mumei is asking whether fire has memories.

steps.prompt: HoloTori must carry the ceremonial flame from the arena to the lighthouse. Subaru is holding the safety manual. Kiara is holding three torches.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru takes the torch with both hands. Kiara gasps. 'The Flock Commander leads us!' 'I am holding this because you brought extras!' Reine adjusts Subaru's grip. Lui clears the route. Mumei looks at the flame. 'Can it remember things?' Subaru starts walking faster. 'Nobody answer that.'

Kiara raises the torch. 'Tonight, HoloTori rises on wings of fire!' Lui takes the other two torches away. 'One wing of fire.' Reine adds a gold ribbon. Subaru checks the extinguisher. Mumei asks, 'Can I hold the smoke?' Everyone says no before she finishes.

Reine replaces the open flame with enclosed lanterns. 'Elegance should not require an evacuation plan.' Kiara looks wounded. Lui looks relieved. Mumei holds her lantern under her chin and frightens three tourists. Subaru points at her. 'That is the opposite of elegance.' Reine sighs. 'Every procession has one experimental section.'

steps.prompt: The prism's beam crosses the parade route. Every lantern flame bends toward the ocean instead of the wind.

options.resultDialogue: Kiara declares the flames are guiding the flock. Lui says, 'The approved route is left.' Every flame points right. Subaru looks between them. 'For once, can the supernatural obey traffic control?' The procession follows the light to the seawall, where the fourth pier flickers into view. Mumei waves. 'Hello, missing road.'

Lui keeps everyone on schedule while the flames strain sideways in their lanterns. Reine maintains formation. Kiara walks backward so she can watch the beam. Subaru grabs her sash before she steps into a fountain. 'Eyes forward!' Kiara points at the ocean. 'But history is happening behind me!'

options.text: Let Mumei carry one flame to the seawall
options.resultDialogue: Mumei walks toward the beam with a lantern. Subaru follows because leaving Mumei alone with mystery and fire violates several policies. The lantern projects a shadow shaped like a pier across the water. Mumei tilts her head. 'I think the island forgot to finish drawing it.' Subaru whispers, 'Please do not say that near the Manager.'

steps.prompt: The torch reaches the lighthouse platform. The fourth pier appears directly beneath the beam, and a seagull lands on the ceremonial switch.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru approaches slowly. 'Nice bird. Normal bird. Not my colleague.' The gull pecks the switch, activating every parade light at once. Kiara points dramatically. 'It has chosen the finale!' Lui grabs the bird with a towel. Reine presses the correct switch. Mumei salutes the gull. 'Former technician.'
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori completed the torch parade and illuminated the fourth pier beneath the lighthouse beam. A seagull received temporary technical credit before Lui removed it from duty.

options.text: Declare the pier part of the parade
options.resultDialogue: Kiara turns toward the crowd. 'Behold—the secret final destination of HoloTori!' Subaru whispers, 'We did not know it existed thirty seconds ago.' Reine continues waving. 'The audience does not require that detail.' The guests cheer as the pier fades. Mumei looks at the empty sea. 'Our destination left.' Lui writes, 'Do not follow disappearing infrastructure.'
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori turned the fourth pier's brief appearance into the parade finale. The guests believed it was planned, while Lui added disappearing infrastructure to tomorrow's safety meeting.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: HoloTori completed the victory torch parade. No new finding occurred, but the prism guided every flame toward the briefly visible fourth pier.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Justice secure the prism, document the fourth pier, and stop Gigi from arresting the lighthouse beam.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has opened an official jurisdiction case. Cecilia is deploying sensors, Raora is preparing to sketch the projection, and Gigi has labeled the lighthouse BIG SUSPECT.

steps.prompt: Justice secures the lighthouse platform. Elizabeth treats the prism activation as a matter of national jurisdiction. Gigi is wearing an equipment-inspector badge she made herself.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia places sensor markers around the prism. 'No one crosses this line without authorization.' Gigi steps over it. Cecilia picks her up and places her back outside. Gigi steps over again. Cecilia repeats the process. Elizabeth watches. 'Is this necessary?' Cecilia replies, 'She is testing system endurance.' Gigi salutes. 'Excellent system.'

options.text: Let Elizabeth open an official case
options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth dictates: 'Case Seven: The Trophy That Contained Infrastructure.' Raora sketches the prism wearing a criminal mask. Gigi points at the drawing. 'Clearly guilty.' Cecilia says, 'The mask is artistic.' Elizabeth adds, 'Possible disguise capability.' Raora quietly adds a tiny mustache.

Gigi circles the tower, tapping every surface. She finds the ceremonial switch and labels it BIG BUTTON. Elizabeth says, 'Do not press it.' Gigi puts both hands behind her back. 'I would never.' The switch clicks under her tail. Cecilia records, 'Statement reliability: zero percent.'

steps.prompt: The lighthouse beam activates before Cecilia completes the startup sequence. A fourth pier appears across the water.

options.resultDialogue: Raora draws quickly. 'The railings are older than the resort style, and there is a sign at the end.' Elizabeth asks what it says. Raora squints at the fading image. 'RETURN STAFF ONLY.' Gigi writes BIRD STAFF beneath it. Cecilia says, 'No avian data detected.' Gigi circles her note twice. 'Hidden avian data.'

options.text: Ask Cecilia why it activated early
options.resultDialogue: Cecilia compares the startup log. 'The structure responded 2.4 seconds before the lighthouse transmitted.' Elizabeth looks toward the pier. 'Then the destination called first.' Gigi cups her hands around her mouth. 'HELLO, CRIME PIER!' The projection flickers brighter. Everyone turns toward her. Gigi whispers, 'It likes me.'

Elizabeth faces the ocean. 'Unregistered structure, identify yourself!' The beam displays a sequence of old staff numbers. Cecilia freezes the image. One line ends in UNIT-Z. Raora lowers her pencil. 'That was on the cracked badge.' Elizabeth opens a second case file. Gigi asks, 'Can cases fight each other?'

steps.prompt: The projection begins fading. Justice has seconds to decide how the island will officially describe the event.

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth signs an emergency order. 'The nonexistent pier is now restricted territory.' You ask, 'Can you restrict something that does not exist?' She stamps the page. 'It exists administratively now.' Gigi places a tiny barricade at the water's edge. Cecilia saves the projection data. Raora titles her sketch THE PIER THAT FILED ITSELF.
options.completionDialogue: Justice secured the lighthouse and officially restricted the fourth pier despite its disappearance. Cecilia confirmed that it responded before activation, and Raora preserved the only complete visual record.

options.text: Keep the pier secret from the guests
options.resultDialogue: Raora closes her sketchbook, Cecilia encrypts the sensor logs, and Elizabeth announces that the beam was a planned finale. Gigi raises her hand. 'Can I tell one bird?' 'No,' everyone answers. The pier fades. Cecilia's prism display flashes CALIBRATION 1 OF 4 COMPLETE before going dark.
options.completionDialogue: Justice concealed the fourth pier as a planned show effect. Behind the stage, the prism confirmed CALIBRATION 1 OF 4 COMPLETE before shutting down.

options.text: Mark the site for tomorrow's inspection
options.resultDialogue: Cecilia calculates the pier's projected coordinates. Raora draws the shoreline reference points. Elizabeth schedules an official inspection. Gigi packs a net, three snacks, and a sign reading PIER ARREST KIT. Elizabeth removes the net. Gigi replaces it when she looks away. The water returns to darkness, but the coordinates remain.
options.completionDialogue: Justice recorded the fourth pier's coordinates for a future inspection. The structure vanished, but its location, UNIT-Z connection, and early response remain in the case file.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Justice completed the lighthouse security operation. No new object was found, but the fourth pier, UNIT-Z connection, and calibration message were documented for the next chapter.

days.storyBeat: The resort wakes to a damaged arena, disputed results, viral replay footage, and several hundred compensation claims. The Manager spends the day repairing the Summer Games aftermath while Justice quietly organizes everything known about the fourth pier. Morning is the only finding window, and every recovered item is mundane tournament debris.

morning.title: Day 8 — Damage, Debris & Denial
morning.openingDialogue: The Summer Games are over. The arena contains one embedded crate, two unauthorized shortcuts, half a parade float, and a sign reading HISTORIC VICTORY CRATER. Before guests arrive, three teams must repair the resort and process the wreckage. Morning is today's only finding window.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Shiranui Kensetsu decide which parts of the arena are repairs and which parts Miko has declared cultural heritage.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare has a clipboard thick enough to stop a hammer. Noel is holding the bent victory arch upright with one hand. Polka has opened a ticket booth beside the crater. Miko has placed a rope around her shortcut and labeled it ELITE HISTORIC SITE. Suisei is calmly sorting debris into 'reusable,' 'flammable,' and 'competitor-shaped.'

steps.prompt: Flare points at the arena. 'We repair the course, remove the hazards, and do not create new attractions.' Polka slowly closes a sign reading CRATER TOURS — 50 SHELLS.

options.resultDialogue: Flare assigns everyone a real job. Noel lifts the arch, Polka gathers foam blocks, and Miko is told to remove the glitter arrows. Miko peels off one arrow and gasps. 'But how will future generations know where not to go?' Suisei points at the crater. 'That communicates it.'

Miko plants a tiny shrine gate over the shortcut. 'This path changed sports history-nye!' Flare looks at the route, which passes through a snack freezer and ends behind a locked restroom. 'It changed plumbing history.' Polka immediately begins selling commemorative maps.

Suisei lifts a demolition hammer. Flare says, 'Only the unsafe parts.' One precise swing removes the damaged rail, the broken sign, and Pekora's unattended shortcut booth thirty meters away. Pekora's distant scream reaches the arena. Suisei rests the hammer on her shoulder. 'Unsafe booth.'

steps.prompt: Noel lifts a collapsed foam wall. Something ordinary from yesterday's tournament is trapped beneath it.

options.resultDialogue: You pull out Subaru's whistle. Miko blows it once. Subaru appears from across the resort at full sprint. 'WHO AUTHORIZED THE START?!' Flare hands her the whistle. Subaru hugs it, then notices everyone staring. 'This is official safety equipment. I am not emotional.'

You find a scorched arrow labeled DEFINITELY OFFICIAL. Pekora reaches for it from behind the barrier. Suisei places one foot on the sign. Pekora freezes. 'I was only checking the evidence-peko.' Suisei smiles. 'From there.'

Polka pulls out a spectator ballot reading MORE EXPLOSIONS NEXT YEAR. She holds it up proudly. Flare takes it, flips it over, and finds the same handwriting as Polka's autograph. Polka points toward the crowd area. 'The people have a distinctive voice.'

steps.prompt: The course is nearly usable again. Flare asks whether the repaired area should return to normal or preserve one reminder of yesterday.

options.resultDialogue: Shiranui Kensetsu restores every rail, platform, and lane marker. Noel straightens the final post with two fingers. Polka looks across the clean arena. 'It's beautiful.' Miko nods. 'Too beautiful. We should damage one corner for authenticity.' Flare raises the clipboard. Miko retreats.
options.completionDialogue: Shiranui Kensetsu restored the Summer Games arena to safe operating condition. The morning finding was ordinary tournament debris, and Miko's shortcut has been removed from every official map except her own.

options.resultDialogue: You preserve a padded section containing one bent hurdle, a harmless crater, and Polka's audience sign. Flare installs three safety rails. Miko cuts the ribbon. 'A monument to elite athletics!' Suisei reads the plaque. 'It says nobody knows who won here.' Polka wipes away a tear. 'Art.'
options.completionDialogue: The arena reopened with a supervised Historic Chaos Corner commemorating the tournament's least explainable moments. Management insists it is an exhibit, not an invitation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Shiranui Kensetsu completed the damage audit. Nothing mysterious was recovered; the main unanswered question is why Polka already had printed crater tickets.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Recover HoloTori's parade float and settle Subaru's latest objection to being called a bird.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The HoloTori float is lodged halfway inside the foam safety pit. Kiara calls it a successful landing. Lui calls it an obstruction. Reine is evaluating feather damage. Mumei is sitting inside the beak. Subaru has arrived with a folder labeled FORMAL NON-BIRD APPEAL — REVISION 14.

steps.prompt: The float must be removed before the arena opens. Kiara proposes a triumphant relaunch. Subaru reads the words 'relaunch' and closes her eyes.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru blows her recovered whistle. 'Lift on three! One, two—KIARA, STOP POSING!' Kiara lowers one wing. Reine coordinates the ropes, Lui directs the crane, and Mumei remains inside the beak because nobody noticed. The float rises perfectly. Mumei waves from above. 'I have become cargo.'

Kiara warms the foam until it loosens. Lui stands beside her with two extinguishers. 'Small flame.' Kiara nods. 'Symbolic flame.' The float pops free, rolls backward, and gently traps Subaru against a padded wall. Kiara raises both hands. 'Rescue complete!' Subaru's voice comes from behind the float. 'RESCUE CONTINUES!'

options.text: Use Reine and Lui's tow plan
options.resultDialogue: Reine arranges the ropes symmetrically while Lui checks every anchor. The float slides out without drama. Kiara watches in horror. 'It simply worked.' Reine adjusts one feather. 'Elegance often resembles competence.' Subaru points at Lui. 'Write that on the safety manual.'

steps.prompt: Something rattles inside the float's storage compartment. Morning rules permit one mundane recovery.

options.resultDialogue: Inside is a laminated HoloTori card reading SUBARU — FLOCK COMMANDER. Subaru stares at Kiara. Kiara whistles innocently. Reine examines the lamination. 'Professionally made.' Lui checks the date. 'Printed before the parade.' Mumei says, 'Destiny had office supplies.'

You pull out the cone that landed on Subaru during rehearsal. It now has forty tourist autographs and the words DUCK COMMANDER. Subaru reaches for a marker. 'Good. I can correct it.' Kiara gives her a permanent marker with no eraser. 'Of course.'

Mumei produces a tourist's rubber duck. Everyone turns toward Subaru. Subaru points at Kiara. 'Say one word and I leave.' Kiara covers her mouth. Reine quietly places the duck beside Subaru. Lui looks away to preserve diplomatic relations.

steps.prompt: The float is recoverable. HoloTori must decide what happens to it next.

options.text: Repair it as a parade attraction
options.resultDialogue: Lui removes the dangerous ramp controls. Reine restores the feathers. Kiara adds a plaque reading FIRST CONTROLLED FLIGHT. Subaru crosses out CONTROLLED. Mumei adds MOSTLY. The attraction opens to a line of delighted guests.
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori repaired the parade float as a stationary guest attraction. It no longer flies, accelerates, or turns without permission, which Kiara considers a temporary design flaw.

options.text: Retire it with a memorial ceremony
options.resultDialogue: Kiara delivers a speech about three seconds of flight. Reine lays down a feather. Lui removes the wheels. Mumei salutes the beak. Subaru is handed the permanent membership card. 'Why is this part of the ceremony?' Kiara smiles. 'Because the flock remembers.' Subaru tears up the appeal form and immediately begins Revision 15.
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori retired the parade float with full honors. Subaru remains an unwilling Flock Commander and has begun another formal appeal.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: HoloTori recovered the parade float and one piece of mundane parade debris. Subaru's species classification remains unresolved by management and extremely resolved by the tourists.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Pekora and Marine process claims caused by questionable maps, dynamic pricing, and audience-funded sabotage.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Pekora has built a claims desk from unsold shortcut maps. Marine is posing beside a sign reading SENCHOU'S OFFICIAL APOLOGY PHOTOS. A queue of guests is holding receipts, foam obstacles, and one helmet with rabbit ears. Pekora whispers, 'Remember, admitting responsibility is expensive-peko.'

steps.prompt: The first guest paid for a shortcut map that led directly into the recovery lounge. Pekora calls this 'premium hydration routing.'

options.resultDialogue: You make Pekora return the fee. She hands over the shells one at a time. 'One... tragic... business unit-peko.' Marine signs the map. 'Senchou's autograph may restore its emotional value.' The guest asks for a second refund.

Pekora prints coupons for one free harmless obstacle assignment next year. The guest asks whether there will be another tournament. Pekora looks at you. 'There is now-peko.' Marine poses with the coupon. 'Senchou supports recurring revenue.'

Marine steps forward. 'Senchou sincerely apologizes that your illegal shortcut lacked sufficient romance.' The guest forgets the complaint long enough to take a photo. Pekora stamps the form RESOLVED. You stamp it NOT RESOLVED. Pekora stamps your stamp SOLD OUT.

steps.prompt: Returned merchandise is piling up behind the desk. One mundane item must be checked before disposal.

options.resultDialogue: The pass says HOLDER CANNOT RECEIVE PENALTIES, TAXES, OR CRITICISM. Elizabeth has written INVALID across it in red ink. Pekora examines the mark. 'This increases collector value-peko.' Marine nods. 'A limited Justice collaboration.'

The returned towel is large enough to cover the desk and features Marine posing beside the words OFFICIAL WINNER. You point out that Marine did not compete. She places one hand on her chest. 'Senchou won the attention economy.' Pekora whispers, 'She has a point-peko.'

The helmet is undamaged despite several dents in the foam ears. Pekora puts it on. 'Proof our safety program worked-peko.' Marine taps one ear. It squeaks. 'And fashionable.' You keep it for next year's liability meeting.

steps.prompt: The claims queue is shrinking. What happens to the remaining merchandise profits?

options.resultDialogue: You redirect the profits to Shiranui Kensetsu. Pekora watches the money leave. 'We earned it through innovation.' Marine adjusts her helmet. 'And lost it through consequences.' Flare sends a receipt labeled THANKS, CRIMINALS. Pekora frames it.
options.completionDialogue: PekoMari processed the claims and funded part of the arena repair bill. Pekora calls it involuntary sponsorship; Marine calls it Senchou's civic contribution.

options.resultDialogue: Marine unveils a shirt reading I SURVIVED THE SUMMER GAMES AND ALL I GOT WAS TARGETED BY FOAM. Pekora adds premium scorch marks. The complaint queue becomes a sales queue in under a minute. You add a mandatory repair donation to every purchase before they notice.
options.completionDialogue: PekoMari converted the remaining complaints into disaster-survivor merchandise sales. Management recovered repair funds, and Marine has declared Senchou the face of athletic resilience.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The refund desk closed with fewer claims than it started and more merchandise than anyone approved. All recovered items were mundane tournament products.

noon.title: Day 8 — Replays, Recovery & Rematches
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the arena is safe enough for guests again. Three groups are assigned to review tournament footage, run competitor recovery, and explain why yesterday's scoreboard briefly classified OkaKoro as one four-legged organism.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Review FAMS's tournament footage while Mio insists nobody became dangerously competitive.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fubuki has three rulebooks and a remote control. Subaru has filed protests against the word bird, the raft penalty, and Korone. Ayame is eating snacks beside the replay screen. Mio has written FRIENDLY REVIEW on the board hard enough to crack the chalk.

steps.prompt: Fubuki asks which clip should open the review. Mio says, 'Choose something that shows teamwork.' The screen is paused on Mio smiling while every nearby competitor backs away.

options.resultDialogue: The replay shows Subaru hanging from the banner while Ayame holds her ankle, Fubuki holds Ayame, and Mio anchors everyone. Subaru points at the screen. 'I was a kite!' Kiara shouts from the back row, 'A bird-shaped kite!' Subaru throws a cushion without looking. It hits Kiara perfectly.

The footage shows Korone adopting a hurdle, Subaru adding more hurdles, and both teams building a foam wall. Mio pauses the video. 'This was not strategy.' Fubuki points at the final scoreboard. 'It produced a crowd bonus.' Mio resumes the video. 'This was regrettably strategy.'

The montage labels FAMS THE SMILING THREAT. Mio freezes the screen. 'Who approved that title?' Fubuki slowly hides a voting slip. Ayame smiles at the image. 'It is cute.' Subaru points at Mio's expression. 'That is the threat part.'

steps.prompt: Subaru demands one formal correction to the tournament record. Fubuki has already prepared six possible loopholes.

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki argues that a raft leaving the water remains a raft until emotionally reclassified. Elizabeth reads the appeal twice. 'Denied.' Subaru slams the table. 'WHY?' Elizabeth points to footage of the raft knocking over a lifeguard chair. 'The chair has submitted testimony.'

Mio receives a plaque reading MOST POLITE INTIMIDATION. 'I do not intimidate people.' The staff member handing it over takes one look at her smile and releases the plaque from two meters away. Ayame applauds. Fubuki whispers, 'Empirical evidence.'

Subaru points at Korone. 'One clean hurdle race. No adoption, no walls, no body checks.' Korone raises her hand. 'Can there be friendship tackles?' 'NO.' Okayu offers Subaru a rice ball. 'You should define clean more carefully.' Subaru takes out a second rulebook.

steps.prompt: The guests want a conclusion to the tribunal. Mio must decide whether FAMS closes the case or performs an exhibition rematch.

options.resultDialogue: Mio stamps the report FINAL. Fubuki produces an addendum. Mio stamps that FINAL. Subaru raises another objection. Mio stamps Subaru's folder FINAL. Ayame places a snack on the stamp before Mio can use it on anyone else.
options.completionDialogue: FAMS closed the official tournament record after several rejected appeals. Mio maintains they were never overly competitive, and the replay remains available to contradict her.

options.resultDialogue: FAMS and OkaKoro enter a tiny padded course. Subaru and Korone collide at the first hurdle and disappear into foam. Ayame crosses the finish line while laughing. Okayu walks around the obstacle and sits beside her. Fubuki checks the rules. Mio tears the rules in half. 'Exhibition concluded.'
options.completionDialogue: The tribunal ended with a harmless foam rematch. Ayame and Okayu technically finished first, while Subaru and Korone achieved a draw by mutual knockout.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FAMS reviewed the tournament and preserved its most important conclusion: everybody remembers Mio becoming competitive except Mio.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help OkaKoro run a recovery lounge where Korone treats rehabilitation as the final round.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Okayu is reclining behind a desk labeled THERAPIST. Korone is wearing six ice packs like championship belts. A line of exhausted competitors waits for advice. Okayu has one rice ball, one clipboard, and no visible medical qualifications.

steps.prompt: Korone announces a full-contact stretching program. Okayu takes a bite of her rice ball. 'Maybe begin with sitting.'

options.resultDialogue: Okayu assigns one snack and ten minutes of silence to every competitor. Korone watches the room become peaceful. 'When do we fight the snacks?' Okayu hands her a hard rice cracker. 'Advanced patient.' Korone accepts the challenge with both hands.

Korone demonstrates by grappling a foam roller. The roller loses. Okayu writes, 'Good range of motion.' Subaru enters, sees Korone pinning exercise equipment, and immediately turns around. Korone waves. 'Your appointment is next!' Subaru begins running.

You organize the supplies while Okayu labels injuries by snack severity. 'Rice cracker, medium. Pudding, serious. Whole cake, Subaru.' Subaru points at her bandages. 'Why am I a cake?' Korone answers, 'Because you have layers.' Nobody understands, including Korone.

steps.prompt: A group of guests asks for a safe demonstration of yesterday's OkaKoro teamwork. Korone hears only the word demonstration.

options.resultDialogue: Korone straps a tiny mascot to her back. Okayu climbs on top as 'weight distribution.' They move three meters before Okayu falls asleep. Korone whispers, 'Manager, do I keep going?' Okayu raises one thumb without waking. Korone completes twelve victory laps.

options.text: Make Korone apologize for obstacle adoption
options.resultDialogue: Korone faces the recovered hurdle. 'I am sorry I moved you without consent.' Subaru folds her arms. 'The apology is for FAMS.' Korone looks at Subaru. 'I am sorry the hurdle chose me.' Okayu writes, 'Progress.' Subaru writes, 'No progress.'

options.text: Turn recovery into a resting contest
options.resultDialogue: Okayu announces the first competitor to move loses. Everyone lies down. Korone vibrates with competitive energy. 'Can I defeat stillness?' 'By not moving,' Okayu says. Korone freezes so intensely that a guest checks whether she is breathing. She is. Aggressively.

steps.prompt: The recovery session needs a final activity that will not create another insurance claim.

options.resultDialogue: Okayu dims the lights. Korone lies beside the door to guard everyone from noise. Five minutes later, she is asleep with one fist raised. Subaru enters quietly, places the recovered whistle on the desk, and backs away. Korone's fist lowers. Crisis avoided.
options.completionDialogue: OkaKoro completed a peaceful recovery session. Korone finally rested, Okayu successfully delegated every task, and no therapy equipment required rescue.

options.resultDialogue: Korone challenges the foam roller to a rematch. She charges, the roller slips, and Korone launches gently into a pile of cushions. Okayu checks the time. 'Fast recovery.' Korone raises a thumb from the cushions and immediately falls asleep.
options.completionDialogue: The recovery clinic ended with Korone temporarily knocking herself out on approved padding. Okayu classified this as successful enforced rest.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: OkaKoro operated the competitor recovery clinic. Guests left relaxed, athletes left fed, and Korone left unconscious only in the safest available cushions.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help FLOW GLOW edit yesterday's chaos into a family-friendly resort film.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Su has loaded twenty hours of footage. Chihaya is labeling accurate timestamps. Vivi is adding sound effects to every collision. Niko has renamed the project LEGENDS NEVER READ SAFETY SIGNS. Riona is trying to remove a frame where she was hit by her own smoke machine.

steps.prompt: The resort needs a public highlight reel. FLOW GLOW disagrees on whether it should be heroic, honest, or legally survivable.

options.resultDialogue: Su adds dramatic music. Chihaya narrates every rescue. Vivi gives Noel's supply throw a meteor sound. The embedded crate now looks intentional. Riona watches Miko's cart explode through a foam gate. 'Can editing make that legal?' Su replies, 'Only cinematic.'

Chihaya removes the dramatic music. The raw audio contains sixteen whistles, nine explosions, and Flare shouting MIKO at regular intervals. Niko listens carefully. 'It has rhythm.' Vivi begins beatboxing along with the safety violations.

options.text: Build the film around team titles
options.resultDialogue: Niko introduces FAMS as THE SMILING THREAT, Shiraken as BUILDING CODE VIOLATION, and OkaKoro as CAT AND DOG, LEGALLY UNMONITORED. Mio appears in the editing room. 'Change ours.' Niko changes it to THE POLITELY REQUESTING THREAT. Mio leaves. Riona whispers, 'Improvement.'

steps.prompt: While scrubbing the lighthouse footage, Su notices one frame showing the fourth pier before the prism activates.

options.text: Treat it as a camera glitch
options.resultDialogue: Su checks three cameras. The same pier appears in all of them for one frame. Riona folds her arms. 'A synchronized glitch.' Chihaya marks the timestamp without comment. Vivi adds no sound effect for the first time all afternoon.

options.text: Hide it as an easter egg
options.resultDialogue: Niko leaves the frame in the public cut for exactly one twenty-fourth of a second. 'The fans will analyze it for weeks.' Su asks whether that is responsible. Niko smiles. 'No. It is engagement.' Chihaya adds a note for Justice before export.

Chihaya exports the original frame. Cecilia replies within seconds: RECEIVED. Gigi replies one second later: PIER CAUGHT ON CAMERA. Elizabeth sends a formal request that nobody add stickers. Niko quietly removes three stickers.

steps.prompt: The screening room is full. Which version premieres to the guests?

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya narrates the rescues, teamwork, and final lighthouse ceremony. The crowd applauds the competitors and laughs at the permitted mistakes. Riona watches her smoke-machine incident pass without comment. Su notices the pier frame. Nobody in the audience reacts. Yet.
options.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW premiered an official Summer Games documentary. The crowd saw teamwork, destruction, and one unexplained frame that may become tomorrow's fan theory.

options.resultDialogue: The screen shows Subaru becoming a kite, Pekora being embedded in foam, Korone challenging furniture, and Miko driving through a snack station. Every featured member begins shouting objections at once. The guests laugh so hard the subtitles cannot keep up. Niko bows. 'Truth is the strongest genre.'
options.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW premiered the tournament blooper reel. It became the resort's highest-rated screening and created six new personal grudges before the credits ended.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW completed the Summer Games replay film. No object was found, but the cameras recorded the fourth pier one frame earlier than expected.

evening.title: Day 8 — Awards After Dark
evening.openingDialogue: The repaired resort hosts one final evening of unofficial awards, quiet music, and administrative denial. The Lighthouse Calibration Prism remains secured. No findings are scheduled, but the fourth pier case refuses to become ordinary paperwork.
