noon.openingDialogue: Noon is today's only finding window. Three maintenance teams can access the newly visible service layer beneath the pier; every route reaches the same old calibration system and the same uncomfortable reference to Manager authority.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Inspect a maintenance hatch beneath the fourth pier and trigger the second calibration.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Towa leads the maintenance team to a hatch now visible below the pier stairs. Kanata is holding the heavy safety gate open, Watame has a rope harness, and Luna is looking at the ladder as if it personally offended royalty.

steps.prompt: The maintenance hatch is sealed by an old mechanical wheel. How do you enter?

options.resultDialogue: Kanata grips the wheel with two fingers. 'Carefully.' The entire hatch frame rotates instead. Towa catches the paperwork before it blows away. Watame stares at the sideways door. 'We opened the wall.' Kanata: 'It was very stuck.'
Towa follows the faded instructions exactly. The lock opens with a clean click. Luna peers down the ladder. 'Carry me.' Towa looks at Kanata. Kanata sighs and becomes royal elevator service.
Watame descends cheerfully, then stops. 'My horns are wider than the hatch.' Towa looks down. Kanata looks up. Luna raises one hand. 'Pull sheep.' The rescue takes longer than opening the door.

steps.prompt: Below the pier is an old maintenance platform with inactive rails and one central calibration console. This is today's finding window.

options.resultDialogue: Towa wipes salt from the controls and follows the startup sequence. The screen lights: CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE. Beneath it: AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER. Watame reads the line twice. 'Manager, are you a password?' Luna: 'Low-security password, nanora.'

options.text: Let Kanata power the old mechanism
options.resultDialogue: Kanata turns the manual generator. The lights come on far too brightly. The console flashes CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE and AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER. Kanata lets go. The lights remain on. 'I don't think that was me.' Towa: 'That is the concerning option.'

steps.prompt: The old platform is active but stable. The console shows one final date: AUGUST 31 — COMMIT.

options.text: Seal the platform after recording it
options.resultDialogue: Towa records the screen and orders everyone out. Luna is carried back up. Watame checks her harness twice. Kanata closes the hatch with one finger and does not rotate the wall this time. 'See? Gentle.'
options.completionDialogue: holoForce completed the under-pier inspection. The old console registered Calibration 2 of 4, identified the Manager as its authority source, and displayed an August 31 commit date.

options.text: Leave the platform powered for monitoring
options.resultDialogue: You keep the old lights on under Towa's supervision. The screen returns to standby with one line: WAITING FOR MANAGEMENT. Watame looks at you. 'No pressure.' Luna: 'Pressure.'
options.completionDialogue: holoForce left the maintenance platform powered for monitoring. Calibration 2 is complete, and the old system is explicitly waiting for the Manager.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: holoForce accessed the maintenance platform beneath the fourth pier and advanced the shared mystery to Calibration 2.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Investigate an old service lift beneath the fourth pier with Myth and reach the same calibration system.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has declared the new pier a crime scene against geography. Ina is studying faded maintenance markings, Calli is carrying emergency gear, and Gura is staring at a button labeled STAFF ONLY.

steps.prompt: An old service lift sits beneath the pier. Gura's finger is already one centimeter from the button.

options.resultDialogue: Amelia blocks Gura with one arm and examines the panel. 'Old system, no visible power, probably safe.' The lift doors open behind her. Gura points. 'Detective.' Amelia: 'I am updating 'probably.''
Ina traces a faded symbol. 'It says return staff only.' Calli looks around. 'Return from where?' The lift dings. Gura steps inside. 'From lunch?' Ina: 'Strong interpretation.'

You let Gura press STAFF ONLY. The lift announces MANAGER PRESENT — ACCESS GRANTED. Amelia slowly turns toward you. Gura presses the button again. 'Say it again.' The lift refuses. 'One-time dialogue.'

steps.prompt: The lift opens onto an old maintenance deck containing a calibration terminal. This is today's finding window.

options.resultDialogue: Amelia photographs the panel before touching anything. Ina points to a lighthouse symbol. Calli keeps Gura three steps from every button. The terminal wakes anyway: CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE. AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER. Amelia lowers the camera. 'Okay. Now it is allowed to be weird.'

options.text: Let Ina activate the lighthouse symbol
options.resultDialogue: Ina touches the symbol. A blue line passes through the platform and out toward the lighthouse. The screen reads CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE. Gura squints at AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER. 'So Manager is the final boss?' Calli: 'Don't give the island genre ideas.'

steps.prompt: A second line appears: AUGUST 31 — COMMIT. The lift begins chiming politely.

options.resultDialogue: Amelia takes the logs. Calli herds everyone into the lift. Gura waves at the terminal. 'Bye, ominous computer.' It replies GOODBYE, GUEST. Gura gasps. 'It knows me!' Amelia: 'It read your badge.' Gura: 'Less magical.'
options.completionDialogue: Myth documented the maintenance deck beneath the fourth pier. Calibration 2 is complete; the system recognizes the Manager as its authority source and is waiting for an August 31 commit.

options.resultDialogue: You type WHAT IS COMMIT? The terminal answers CONFIGURATION. Amelia types CONFIGURATION OF WHAT? It returns PLEASE COMPLETE CALIBRATION. Gura types FISH? The terminal goes to sleep. Calli: 'You offended it.'
options.completionDialogue: Myth completed Calibration 2 and learned only that an August 31 'configuration commit' is waiting. Gura also learned that the terminal will ignore seafood questions.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Myth reached the maintenance layer beneath the fourth pier and confirmed that the old system is responding specifically to the Manager.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Send holoh3ro beneath the pier, where Kaela immediately understands more of the machinery than anyone wanted.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela is staring through the pier grating at an old service deck below. Zeta has a waterproof notebook. Kobo has a megaphone for communicating with maintenance equipment, which is not a real procedure.

steps.prompt: The service platform can be reached by a narrow maintenance ladder or an old cargo hoist.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela checks the cables once and steps onto the hoist. Zeta follows. Kobo jumps aboard with the megaphone. 'DOWN!' The hoist begins descending before Kaela touches the controls. Zeta looks at Kobo. Kobo looks at the hoist. 'It respects confidence.' Kaela: 'No.'
Zeta slips down quietly. Kobo leans over the rail. 'REPORT!' Zeta's voice comes from directly behind her. 'Clear.' Kobo jumps into Kaela's arms. Kaela does not react. 'Scout result received.'

Kobo presses the maintenance intercom. 'HELLO, UNDERGROUND PEOPLE!' The platform lights switch on in sequence. Kaela looks down. 'No people.' Kobo lowers the mic. 'Underground electricity, then.' Zeta writes, 'It answered.'

steps.prompt: The old machinery centers on a calibration console connected to the lighthouse. This is today's finding window.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela resets two breakers and turns one corroded wheel. The machine wakes with a clean hum. CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE. AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER. Kobo points at you. 'YOU ARE MACHINE BOSS.' Zeta: 'That title should not become official.'

Zeta follows the cable path to the lighthouse relay while Kaela keeps the system stable. The terminal activates on its own: CALIBRATION 2 OF 4 COMPLETE. Kobo reads AUGUST 31 — COMMIT. 'Commit what?' Zeta: 'Probably not crime.' Kobo: 'Disappointing.'

steps.prompt: The service deck stabilizes. What should holoh3ro do before leaving?

options.resultDialogue: Kaela restores the safety covers. Zeta logs the route. Kobo adds a sticker reading DO NOT YELL INTO INTERCOM. Kaela looks at her. Kobo: 'For future people.' Kaela: 'For you.'
options.completionDialogue: holoh3ro restored the under-pier machinery and completed Calibration 2. The system identifies the Manager as its authority source and lists an August 31 configuration commit.

options.text: Leave a sensor on the console
options.resultDialogue: Zeta places a monitor on the console. The screen immediately labels it APPROVED OBSERVER. Zeta stares. Kobo whispers, 'Promoted.' Kaela turns off Kobo's megaphone before she can request a title.
options.completionDialogue: holoh3ro left a safe monitor on the maintenance console after completing Calibration 2. The old system accepted the sensor as if it had been waiting for permission.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: holoh3ro restored the machinery beneath the fourth pier and completed the same second calibration reached by the other investigation routes.

evening.title: Day 11 — Open for Business
evening.openingDialogue: By evening, management does what management always does with unexplained supernatural infrastructure: opens it to guests under supervision. A festival, guided tours, and a calm closing shift keep the tone light while Calibration 2 remains active below.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Turn the fourth pier into a harmless evening festival before Matsuri turns 'opening ceremony' into a legal status.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The pier is safe for supervised guests. Matsuri has lanterns, Aki has music, Haachama has a food stall that has already failed one visual inspection, and Mel is handling the ribbon because nobody trusts Haachama with scissors.

steps.prompt: Matsuri wants a memorable opening ceremony for the pier.

options.resultDialogue: Mel holds the ribbon. Aki starts the music. Matsuri raises the scissors and shouts, 'BY THE POWER OF FESTIVAL!' The ribbon cuts itself before the scissors touch it. Matsuri freezes. 'It respects me.' Haachama: 'Ask it to cook.' Everyone: 'NO.'

options.text: Let Aki lead a dance opening
options.resultDialogue: Aki starts a graceful dance down the pier. The lanterns begin following her steps one by one. Matsuri joins and the lights speed up. Haachama jumps in; half the lanterns turn red. Mel catches one before it hits the food stall. 'The lighting has opinions.'

options.text: Let Haachama open the food lane
options.resultDialogue: Haachama unveils a dish labeled FOURTH PIER SPECIAL. Nobody knows what is in it. The pier's digital menu immediately adds OFFICIAL LOCAL CUISINE. Matsuri screams with laughter. Mel removes the word OFFICIAL. It reappears. Aki: 'Maybe do not feed the infrastructure.'

steps.prompt: The festival is popular enough that every joke announcement is being copied onto pier signage.

options.text: Make Matsuri read from a script
options.resultDialogue: Mel hands Matsuri a strict script. Matsuri reads exactly: 'Please enjoy the evening safely.' The sign displays the same sentence. Everyone exhales. Matsuri adds, 'AND WORSHIP FESTIVAL!' The sign starts typing. Mel clamps a hand over her mouth.

Aki calmly directs guests, and the signs behave. Haachama leans toward the mic. Aki moves it away without breaking rhythm. Haachama follows. The microphone stand slowly extends to stay out of reach. Haachama looks at you. 'The equipment is bullying me.'

steps.prompt: The festival is ready to close. What final message do you approve?

options.resultDialogue: You approve a simple thank-you. The lanterns dim. Matsuri waits for something impossible to happen. Nothing does. She looks almost disappointed. Mel pats her shoulder. 'Congratulations. Reality ignored you.'
options.completionDialogue: Gen 1 closed the pier festival peacefully. For nearly a full minute, the island behaved like an ordinary resort.

options.resultDialogue: You say, 'The fourth pier is officially open.' Every map, sign, and timetable updates at once. A small line appears under the name: AUTHORIZED BY MANAGER. Haachama points at it. 'So you really are the final boss.' Matsuri: 'No, the mayor!' You reject both titles.
options.completionDialogue: Gen 1 closed the festival by formally opening the fourth pier. The island immediately recorded the Manager's declaration as authority.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Gen 1 completed the first public festival on the fourth pier. Matsuri is lobbying for more ribbon-based governance.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Run the first guided pier tours with NePoLaBo and stop Polka from treating every safety feature as audience participation.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The fourth pier needs guest tours. Lamy has refreshments, Botan has a precise route, Nene has volunteer husbands again, and Polka has somehow obtained a whistle marked TOUR GUIDE.

steps.prompt: Who leads the first tour?

options.text: Let Botan run a tactical tour
options.resultDialogue: Botan points out exits, railings, and safe viewing zones with military precision. A guest asks where the best photo spot is. Botan points. 'There. Low crosswind, no glare, two escape routes.' Lamy whispers, 'You made tourism sound like extraction.'

Polka starts the tour with, 'WELCOME TO THE PIER THAT DID NOT EXIST YESTERDAY!' Lamy nearly drops the drink tray. Botan: 'Technically accurate.' Polka points at the emergency ladder. 'SECRET BOSS ENTRANCE!' Botan: 'No longer accurate.'

Nene assigns volunteers to every tour group. Each wears a badge reading HUSBAND GUIDE. One tourist asks if marriage is mandatory. Lamy answers 'No' at the same moment Nene answers 'Welcome to the family!' Botan changes the badge to SUPPORT GUIDE while Nene is distracted.

steps.prompt: Polka notices an emergency demonstration button already labeled DO NOT USE FOR ENTERTAINMENT.

options.text: Move Polka away from the button
options.resultDialogue: Botan silently steps between Polka and the button. Polka moves left. Botan moves left. Polka moves right. Botan moves right. Nene begins commentating like a sports match. Lamy removes the button cover entirely and takes it with her.

You authorize a safety demo. A rescue ladder deploys neatly. Polka throws both arms up. 'ENCORE!' The system does nothing. She presses the button. Still nothing. Botan smiles. 'Single-use permission.' Polka looks at you. 'Manager has cooldowns.'

steps.prompt: The final tour returns safely. What style continues tomorrow?

options.resultDialogue: You adopt Botan's route with Lamy's refreshments and Nene's volunteers. Polka receives a whistle with no moving parts. She blows it. It squeaks sadly. Botan: 'Safety model.'
options.completionDialogue: NePoLaBo established a safe guided tour for the fourth pier. Polka has been issued decoy equipment.

options.resultDialogue: You allow Polka one scripted spectacle per tour. She reads the restriction, smiles, and asks what counts as one spectacle. Botan immediately adds three pages of definitions. Lamy pours herself a drink that is definitely just juice.
options.completionDialogue: NePoLaBo created an entertaining supervised pier tour. Management has learned to define 'one spectacle' before Polka does.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: NePoLaBo completed the first guided tours without losing a guest, a railing, or jurisdiction.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Close the fourth pier for the night with Sora and Roboco after the structure starts drifting a few centimeters from shore.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora is thanking the last guests while Roboco monitors the pier's alignment. Everything is calm until Roboco's display shows the pier has moved six centimeters away from the lighthouse.

steps.prompt: The pier continues drifting slowly. Roboco says, 'High-spec diagnosis: land should not do that.' How do you respond?

options.text: Ask Sora to reassure the guests
options.resultDialogue: Sora smiles into the microphone. 'Everyone, please remain where you are for just a moment.' The guests stop. The pier stops. Roboco looks at her scanner. 'Manager... she told the people, but the infrastructure listened too.' Sora: 'Oh.'

Roboco connects her tablet to the pier controls. 'High-spec manual correction!' She taps ALIGN. The pier moves six centimeters back, then her tablet disconnects because the battery is at 1%. Roboco looks at it. 'High-spec power management.' Sora hands her a charger.

options.text: Tell the pier to stay put
options.resultDialogue: You say, 'Stay there.' The pier stops immediately. Sora looks at you. Roboco looks at you. You look at the pier. Roboco checks three sensors. 'I would like to classify that as coincidence.' The pier moves one centimeter. You say, 'No.' It moves back.

steps.prompt: Roboco compares today's calibration record with the pier response.

options.text: Treat it as a control-system quirk
options.resultDialogue: Roboco writes CONTROL QUIRK. The monitor auto-corrects it to AUTHORITY RESPONSE. She changes it back. The monitor changes it again. Sora watches the argument. 'Maybe it feels strongly about terminology.' Roboco: 'Machines should not win edits.'

options.text: Ask Sora to make one more polite request
options.resultDialogue: Sora faces the pier. 'Please stay safely connected overnight.' The locking clamps engage one by one. Roboco's jaw drops. Sora bows slightly to the pier. 'Thank you.' Roboco: 'Do not establish manners as a control protocol.'

steps.prompt: The fourth pier is secured for the night. Roboco's monitor still shows CALIBRATION 2/4 and AUTHORITY SOURCE — MANAGER.

options.text: End the night without overthinking it
options.resultDialogue: You close the pier. Sora waves goodnight to the empty walkway. One lamp blinks twice. Roboco immediately says, 'Electrical fluctuation.' Sora: 'Of course.' The lamp blinks again. Roboco turns it off.
options.completionDialogue: Gen 0 secured the fourth pier for the night. Calibration 2 remains active, but the resort closes on schedule and nobody is allowed to ask the lamp questions.

options.resultDialogue: Roboco sets an overnight alarm. The monitor displays WAITING FOR MANAGEMENT. She looks at you. 'I think the island thinks you're on call.' Sora smiles sympathetically. 'Manager work is hard.' You consider changing careers.
options.completionDialogue: Gen 0 secured the fourth pier and left the calibration system under observation. The last screen of the night reads WAITING FOR MANAGEMENT.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Gen 0 closed the fourth pier safely. Sora has now demonstrated that politeness may be a valid infrastructure command.
